# Economy

## Purpose
Zombie-match economy: loot zombies drop, carrying it, selling it at the sell zone for money, and the shop zone where money buys a heal, a shield or a faster trigger.

## Concepts
money, wallet, loot, pickup, sell zone, shop zone, CD_Loot, CD_Shop, EconomyNetworkView
